record.original_question: For the modified Wilson polynomial W̃_n(z²; κ, τ, η, ξ), which the source says satisfies a deformed three-term recursion relation and which Ref. [17] calls the Racah-Heun polynomial, can one determine its missing analytic properties and an explicit closed form? The source specifically frames this as deriving analytic properties such as weight functions, generating functions, asymptotics, orthogonality relations, Rodrigues-type formulas, forward/backward shift operator relations, and zeros, and expressing the polynomial in closed form where possible.

evidence.quote: In Ref. [17], the Authors refer to W̃_n(z²; κ,τ,η,ξ) as the ‘Racah-Heun polynomial’ but none of its analytic properties was given.

The sought-after properties of these polynomials include the weight functions, generating functions, asymptotics, orthogonality relations, Rodrigues-type formulas, Forward/Backward shift operator relations, zeros, etc.

artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work introduced the Heun–Racah and Heun–Bannai–Ito algebras (e.g., Bergeron–Gaboriaud–Vinet–Zhedanov, 2020) which provide an algebraic framework for operators of "Heun–Racah" type, including bispectral and tridiagonalization aspects. However, no source located gives a full description of weight functions, orthogonality, Rodrigues-type formulas, generating functions, asymptotics, shift operators, zeros, and an explicit closed form for the modified Wilson / Racah–Heun polynomial family $\widetilde{W}_n(z^2;\kappa,\tau,\eta,\xi)$. The status of obtaining the complete set of these analytic properties appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The Heun-Racah and Heun-Bannai-Ito algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Specializations of these algebras realized by operators obtained by applying the algebraic Heun construct to the bispectral operators of the Racah and Bannai–Ito polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Algebraic framework for Heun–Racah operators exists, but explicit analytic properties of the polynomial family are not fully provided.

status_evidence.title: DLMF: Chapter 31 Heun Functions
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference does not list closed-form modified Wilson / Racah–Heun polynomials with their orthogonality structure.
